sections_read: 11. Updating Metadata, Key Rollover, and Revocation
11.2 Key Rollover for a Trust Anchor
11.3 Redundant Retrieval of Trust Anchor Keys
claims_supported: Trust Chains must be refreshed when they expire; refresh frequency is local.
Entity Configuration exp controls retrieval of updated Federation Keys.
Trust Anchor rollover adds new keys, keeps old keys long enough, switches, then removes old keys.
Independent Trust Anchor key retrieval is recommended for Web PKI compromise.
The specification does not define a revocation process; federations may define their own.
